items.title: IHG With Sumitomo Mitsui Card To Launch To Cobranded Visa Cards In Japan In The First Half Of 2027
items.why: Watch whether this Japan co-brand carries a premium benefit set; it shows how IHG pairs hotel status with Visa abroad.
